title: fix(cli): validate --expires-in when creating api keys
author: Saauf

gist.summary: `polli keys create` now requires `--expires-in` to be an integer number of seconds from 1 to 31,536,000 (365 days). Invalid values such as `30d` or `abc` fail instead of silently creating a non-expiring API key. Unit tests cover valid seconds and invalid inputs.
